Cast from shore, dock or watercraft, and reel back in to locate and display fish on your iPhone or iPad. With the STRIKER Cast GPS model, you can even create your own custom maps with 1’ contours. 

This app is not intended to be a standalone fishing or sonar app.

•	Sonar streams wirelessly from up to 200’ away
•	Displays fish and structure in crisp, easy-to-interpret detail
•	Choose from easy-to-understand traditional 2-D sonar and ice fishing flasher modes
•	Includes automatic setting adjustments for gain, range and more
•	Access maps with up to 1’ contours from the Garmin Quickdraw™ Community or create your own
•	Mark your favorite fishing spots so you can easily find your way back

Make your first cast a STRIKER Cast.
